title: Deucalion
summary: Raleigh names Deucalion in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). The later Deucalion, son of Minos, whom Homer puts in Ulysses’s mouth. Kept apart from Deucalion son of Prometheus. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter VI, §. V, sig. 210b
